jobs.title: Customer Success Associate
jobs.description:
We're hiring for a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company that empowers organizations to proactively identify and fix exploitable attack vectors. Their innovative platform delivers autonomous penetration tests and assessment operations across diverse environments, adopted by a wide range of clients from educational institutions to Global 100 enterprises.

The Role
• Manage a scaled portfolio of customers, leveraging metrics and health signals to drive engagement.
• Build trusted relationships with customer champions and help them communicate security outcomes.
• Drive customer onboarding and adoption through digital touchpoints and targeted outreach.
• Monitor customer health, identify risks, and execute intervention plans.
• Support renewal and expansion efforts by documenting customer outcomes and usage trends.
• Partner cross-functionally to capture and communicate customer feedback to Product, Engineering, and Sales teams.

What You'll Need
• 1-2+ years of relevant experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related customer-facing role.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.
• Comfort using data and customer signals to prioritize work and manage risk.
• Excellent organization and follow-through skills across multiple customers and deadlines.
• A proactive, customer-focused approach and a strong ownership mentality.
• Interest in cybersecurity, security operations, or vulnerability management is preferred.

What's On Offer
• Competitive annual salary of $110,000 - $130,000 OTE (80/20 split), plus equity.
• Opportunities for professional growth within a dynamic and innovative company.
• A collaborative and inclusive team environment focused on solving critical cybersecurity challenges.
• Fully remote work arrangement with potential for limited travel.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
We're hiring for a leading AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. This organization pushes the boundaries of AI capabilities and seeks to safely deploy them globally through its innovative products.

The Role
• Own and manage relationships with a portfolio of advertising partners, acting as their primary point of contact.
• Guide advertisers through onboarding and campaign launches to ensure successful adoption of advertising products.
• Analyze campaign performance and provide actionable recommendations for improved outcomes.
• Identify opportunities to expand partnerships through increased product adoption and investment.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Analytics, Policy, and Operations to resolve issues and enhance platform value.
• Surface advertiser feedback and insights to inform product improvements and long-term strategy.

What You'll Need
• 5-10+ years of experience in digital advertising, account management, customer success, consulting, or a related client-facing role.
• Experience managing advertiser or agency relationships within a platform, publisher, or adtech environment.
• Ability to interpret performance data and translate insights into strategic recommendations.
• Experience with data querying tools such as SQL or advanced Excel/Google Sheets.
• Strong communication skills to build trust with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• A proactive approach with ownership and accountability in fast-paced, evolving environments.

What's On Offer
• Competitive salary
• Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technology.
• A role at the intersection of relationship management, strategy, and execution.
• Contribute to shaping the future of AI and its responsible adoption.

Apply via Haystack today!
